answer: Weight voting power by a delayed tide of independent paid demand, not by how many keys an operator can mint. When a job settles, buyer and seller each post a cipher of their funding path, relays, and payout address. A later random window opens those commitments and graphs them; identities that collapse into the same nebula of overlapping wallets or hosts are fused, and their unvested seats are burned. Aliases are cheap to stamp; a separate paying tide for each alias is not.
